parole.significato: Any of the North American flowering plants of the genus Camassia.
parole.testo: Perhaps from Chinook Jargon qamaš, qawaš (“camas”), from Nootka qawaš (“camas”), or perhaps from Nez Perce qém̓es (“camas”).
Borrowed from Chinook Jargon tlatoa (“to go”), from Nootka ƛatw̕a (“to paddle away”).

parole.significato: Beads or shells, especially as placed on strings and valued as ornaments or a sort of currency.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Chinook Jargon hywka, hyakwa, from Nootka.
